sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior applicability and ship-owner instructions, but remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1/sh:maxCount 1 constraint on nltl:effectiveIceLoadCycleCount. The derived result is required only for a ship linked through nltl:hasComponent to an applicable nltl:propellerIceInteractionComponent; a ship with no such component must not fail merely because the result is absent. Encode conditional result existence and the bounded Nice*Z tolerance check without allowing missing applicability evidence or a missing required result on an applicable ship to pass. Retain the existing ship-owned operand paths, QUDT QuantityValue/type, decimal numericValue, unitless unit, and permitted arithmetic tolerance.
